plan.decision: Strictly larger up/down absolute three-class score; ties abstain; no renormalization after removing neutral.
plan.selection: Discovery only; >=500 decisive, >=100 each asset, >=58% win and positive net; highest Bonferroni-Wilson lower, lexical tie.
plan.later_disclosure: All eight candidates and their continuous 2bp adverse-entry stresses; no reselection.
plan.execution_robustness_gates: Selected 2bp adverse-entry net must be positive in validation, confirmation and continuous later history; every stressed settled bankroll must still fund one stake.
plan.feature_policy: Read-only source/content verification of existing 60-feature store; no rebuild or network.
plan.prediction_policy: Separate resumable atomic cache; each asset/fold trains only on labels settled strictly before cutoff.
plan.baseline_policy: Original verified 60-feature scores; same calendar and observation population.

limitations: This is another bounded family after more than one hundred variations on reused history; not pristine validation.
The two-basis-point label margin is predeclared, not tuned using later returns; it cannot guarantee live execution robustness.
Scores measure three target classes and are not calibrated event win probabilities; neutral outcomes remain in training.
All eight later outcomes and 2bp stresses are disclosed for audit, never for replacing the discovery selection.
Five-minute training targets overlap; weekly blocks do not rule out longer dependence or regime shifts.
Minute index opens are proxies for live strike/expiry prices; known availability dates are an incomplete calendar.
No live model, production rule, alert, remote repository, server or order was changed.
